6-Bode_Magnitude_Plot_v2_No_Norm.comment:
Generic Plotting Tool: Quickly draw beautiful multi-curve comparison plots by specifying column names.

【Features】

1. Comparison: Plot up to 5 curves (y0 to y4).
2. Auto-Marking: Automatically find points on curves at specified X positions.
3. Dynamic Labels: Display values at marked points with custom formatting.

【Common Uses】

- Plot LSV polarization curves and mark potential at 10mA/cm².
- Compare curves at different scan rates.
- Mark current values at specific voltages.
